title: Dock training video
text:

[0:06] The slide changes to show "Step 1" and "Hold the red reset button on the dock for 5 seconds".
[0:12] The slide changes to show "Step 2" and "Wait up to 30 seconds for the dock light to turn green".
[0:18] The slide changes to show "Step 3" and "Still red? Tag the dock OUT OF SERVICE and call the technician on duty".

title: Voicemail from a rider, 6 April 2026
text: [0:00] Hi, this is Sam Carter, member number 20417, calling on Monday the 6th of April. [0:07] On Saturday, the e-bike I took from Riverfront Park lost all power halfway across the Green Island Bridge and I had to push it the rest of the way. [0:16] The bike number was 9012. [0:18] I would like a refund for that ride, please. [0:22] You can call me back on 518-555-0199. [0:28] Thanks. Bye.
